dialogue.content: こんにちは。マッチングありがとうございます。テーマ：カウンセラー部門「いじめ」12時35分終了予定となります。どうぞよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for matching with me. The theme for this session is "Bullying." We are scheduled to finish at 12:35. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: I look forward to working with you, too.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。もしよかったら、はじめに年齢と性別を教えていただいても大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. If it’s alright with you, could you please share your age and gender to start?

dialogue.content: 40代 女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 40s.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 高校でのことです
dialogue.English: It's about something that happened in high school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: お話できる範囲で大丈夫なので、
dialogue.English: You only need to share what you're comfortable with,

dialogue.content: 詳しく聞かせてもらっていいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: so could you please tell me more about it?

dialogue.content: 一部の子達がやりたい放題で
dialogue.English: Some of the kids were doing whatever they wanted,

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 先生の話も指摘も聞かないですし
dialogue.English: They wouldn't listen to the teachers or their corrections,

dialogue.content: 同じクラスの子達にも
dialogue.English: and to the other kids in our class,

dialogue.content: うん、うん。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 物を飛ばしたり後ろから椅子を蹴ったりするので
dialogue.English: they would throw things and kick other people's chairs from behind,

dialogue.content: 見ているのがしんどくなってきて
dialogue.English: and it became emotionally draining to watch.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね…
dialogue.English: I understand...

dialogue.content: 注意したら
dialogue.English: When I spoke up,

dialogue.content: 私が攻撃されるようになりました
dialogue.English: I became their target.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…
dialogue.English: Oh, that's what happened...

dialogue.content: あなたは、先生なのですか？
dialogue.English: Are you a teacher?

dialogue.content: あっ すみません私の高校生の時の話です
dialogue.English: Oh, sorry. This was about when I was in high school.

dialogue.content: ああ、了解です。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Ah, I see. Thank you for clarifying.

dialogue.content: クラスにやんちゃな一部のクラスメートがいて、
dialogue.English: So, there was a group of rowdy classmates in your class,

dialogue.content: みんなのためにも、
dialogue.English: and for everyone's sake,

dialogue.content: なんとかしたいと、思われたのですね。
dialogue.English: you felt you had to do something about it.

dialogue.content: 攻撃…というのは、どんなことがありましたか？
dialogue.English: When you say you became their 'target,' what kinds of things happened?

dialogue.content: はい何もせずにはいられませんでした
dialogue.English: Yes, I felt I couldn't just stand by and do nothing.

dialogue.content: うん、うん。そうですよね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, mm-hm. That makes sense.

dialogue.content: トイレに連れ込まれてホースで水をかけられたり
dialogue.English: They would drag me into the bathroom and spray me with water from a hose,

dialogue.content: えええ…！？
dialogue.English: Oh my goodness...!?

dialogue.content: 廊下を歩いているときに飛び蹴りをされたりしました
dialogue.English: and they would fly-kick me when I was walking down the hallway.

dialogue.content: そんなことが…
dialogue.English: That that happened to you...

dialogue.content: つらい経験をされてこられましたね…
dialogue.English: You've been through such a painful experience...

dialogue.content: 辛いという思いより
dialogue.English: More than the feeling of it being painful,

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なぜそんなことが出きるのかって
dialogue.English: I wondered how it was possible for them to do such things.

dialogue.content: 不思議でした
dialogue.English: I just couldn't understand it.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: この相談の中で、そこをお話しできたら、スッキリしそうですか？
dialogue.English: If we're able to talk about that in this session, do you think that would help you feel a sense of clarity?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Okay. Thank you.

dialogue.content: その子達に私はなりに一生懸命
dialogue.English: I tried my best, in my own way, with those kids...

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なぜそういうことをするのか
dialogue.English: I asked them why they did those kinds of things,

dialogue.content: 聞いたりして気持ちを教えてほしいと
dialogue.English: and told them I wanted them to explain their feelings to me,

dialogue.content: 問いかけていたのですが
dialogue.English: I kept trying to ask them, but...

dialogue.content: うん、うん。ご自身でも行動されてこられたのですね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, mm-hm. So you took action on your own.

dialogue.content: その子達にとっては勘にさわってしまったらしく
dialogue.English: but it seems that just got on their nerves,

dialogue.content: 悪化してしまいました
dialogue.English: and it made things worse.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね…
dialogue.English: So that's what happened...

dialogue.content: あなた自身は、冷静に、
dialogue.English: You, yourself, were able to stay calm,

dialogue.content: 今後のためにも、その子達の気持ちを聴く、
dialogue.English: and for their own good in the future, to listen to their feelings—

dialogue.content: という行動ができたこと、素晴らしいですね。
dialogue.English: the fact that you were able to take that action is truly wonderful.

dialogue.content: その時は、どんなふうに、問いかけられたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How did you approach them when you asked them about it?

dialogue.content: 人を傷つけることを
dialogue.English: I told them that hurting other people

dialogue.content: してしまうと自分自身も苦しくなっちゃうよって
dialogue.English: ultimately ends up making you suffer, too.

dialogue.content: うん、うん。
dialogue.English: Uh-huh.

dialogue.content: 何か今辛いことを抱えているのなら
dialogue.English: and that if they were dealing with something painful,

dialogue.content: 教えてほしいって伝えました
dialogue.English: I wanted them to tell me about it.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 教えてくれて、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一部の子、というのは何人くらいでしたか？
dialogue.English: That group of kids you mentioned, about how many of them were there?

dialogue.content: 男女合わせて7人位です
dialogue.English: There were about seven of them in total, boys and girls.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 高校生くらいだと、それくらいのグループというのは、
dialogue.English: For kids around high school age, a group of that size

dialogue.content: よくありますよね。
dialogue.English: is pretty common, isn't it?

dialogue.content: その中にバットを振り回していたリーダーみたいな子がいました。
dialogue.English: In that group, there was a kid who was like the leader and would swing a baseball bat around.

dialogue.content: バットを…
dialogue.English: A bat...

dialogue.content: 周りから見ると、本当に怖いですね…
dialogue.English: That must have been truly frightening for anyone watching...

dialogue.content: はい😅
dialogue.English: Yes... (chuckles nervously)

dialogue.content: その子達は、プライドも高かったのではありませんか？
dialogue.English: Is it possible those kids had a lot of pride, too?

dialogue.content: 自分達が偉いと思っていたみたいです
dialogue.English: It seemed like they thought they were hot stuff.

dialogue.content: うんうん。その子達は、もしかしたら…
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. It's possible that for those kids...

dialogue.content: 自尊心や自分のパワーなど、自我というものを、
dialogue.English: it was a time where they were trying to establish their own egos,

dialogue.content: 確かめている時期だったのかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: things like their self-esteem and their own sense of power.

dialogue.content: そうだったと思います
dialogue.English: I think that was probably it.

dialogue.content: 先生の言うこととか、社会的な常識にも、
dialogue.English: That they had the power to rebel against what teachers say, or even common sense,

dialogue.content: 反抗できる力があるんだ。と…
dialogue.English: was their way of thinking...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: リーダーがそうだとすると、
dialogue.English: And if the leader is that way,

dialogue.content: グループの人は、仲間はずれが怖くかったり…
dialogue.English: the other group members might be afraid of being ostracized...

dialogue.content: リーダーからしても、仲間がそうなのに、
dialogue.English: And from the leader's perspective, with his friends all being that way,

dialogue.content: 自分が示しをつけるんだ、みたいな気持ちがあったり。
dialogue.English: he may have felt that he had to be the one to set an example.

dialogue.content: ただ…
dialogue.English: But...

dialogue.content: あなたも、周りも、とても苦しい想いでしたね…
dialogue.English: that must have been an incredibly painful experience for both you and everyone around you...

dialogue.content: はいリーダーが怖いので本当はそうしたくないのに従っている子も多かったです。
dialogue.English: Yes. There were many kids who followed him because they were scared of the leader, even though they didn't really want to.

dialogue.content: うん、うん。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 従わなければいけないと
dialogue.English: The feeling that you had to obey them

dialogue.content: いうクラスの雰囲気が
dialogue.English: created an atmosphere in the classroom

dialogue.content: とても重いものでした
dialogue.English: that was very oppressive.

dialogue.content: そうですよね…
dialogue.English: I can only imagine...

dialogue.content: その中でも、あなたは、
dialogue.English: And yet, even in that situation, you...

dialogue.content: みんなのために注意したり、気持ちを聴くべく行動したり…
dialogue.English: spoke up for everyone's sake and took action to try and understand their feelings...

dialogue.content: とても、よくやってこられましたね。
dialogue.English: you handled that so incredibly well.

dialogue.content: もしかしたら、
dialogue.English: Perhaps,

dialogue.content: 自分が出来ることをしなかったら後悔すると思いました
dialogue.English: I thought I would regret it if I didn't do what I could.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 立派なお考えだと、私は思います。
dialogue.English: I think that's a very admirable way of thinking.

dialogue.content: その子達に、あなたが問いかけたとき、
dialogue.English: When you asked them about it,

dialogue.content: ありがとうございますでも
dialogue.English: Thank you, but...

dialogue.content: でも？
dialogue.English: But?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 【ロールプレイ終了】
dialogue.English: [End of Role-Play]

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。この後、評価の方、よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. Please proceed with the evaluation now.
